subject: Subscription credit sweep & VAT proration - remittance and journal playbook
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Vertex Cloud <finance@vertexcloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Sep 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Subscription credits applied to September invoices — request for remittance advices + VAT detail

Hi Anna / Vertex finance team,

We ran a reconciliation for September and see a set of unapplied subscription credits and a bundle of small remits that appear to have been netted on your side. To complete our AR and VAT mapping for Q3 cutoffs we need:

- Remittance advices (PDF or CSV) for payments posted on 2028-09-15 through 2028-09-22.
- A short mapping of which credits were applied to which invoice numbers (or a credit schedule).
- Confirmation of the VAT treatment for those credits (were they VAT-inclusive refunds, or as non-taxable credits?) and the tax ID used.

I've cc'd our AR leads (Laura and Marcus) — we can do a short screenshare if that helps. If you can drop the remittance CSV and the credit schedule, we'll propose journal entries to clear unapplied balances and capture any VAT reversals.

Thanks,
Soojin
Sr. AR Specialist
Redwood Inference
[Attachment requested: vertex_remit_2028-09.csv (csv)]

From: Vertex Cloud <finance@vertexcloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Sep 2028 03:06:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Subscription credits applied to September invoices — request for remittance advices + VAT detail

Hi Soojin — attaching the remittance export and a credit schedule.

Summary:
- Payments on 2028-09-15 through 2028-09-22 were consolidated into a single sweep on 2028-09-22 (bank reference VTX-SWEEP-0922).
- We applied customer-level credits against oldest open invoices by our policy; credit breakdown in the attached spreadsheet.
- VAT treatment: credits were issued net of VAT (we reported original invoices as standard-rated). For refunds where VAT was charged originally, we issued a VAT-adjusted credit; those rows are flagged in the sheet (column: vat_flag = YES).

Files attached: vertex_remit_2028-09.csv, vertex_credit_schedule_q3.xlsx

If you need a signed remittance PDF for audit, say the word and we'll get it over.

Best,
Anna Cho
Finance Manager | Vertex Cloud
[Attachment: vertex_remit_2028-09.csv (csv)]
[Attachment: vertex_credit_schedule_q3.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Sep 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Subscription credits applied to September invoices — remits received, next steps for AR clearing + VAT journal

Forwarding Vertex remit + schedule. Quick read: a consolidated bank sweep + per-customer credit mapping; some credits are VAT-flagged.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Run unapplied-credit allocation: apply credits to invoices per Vertex schedule, post AR clearing journals.
2) For VAT-flagged credits, record a VAT reversal journal that mirrors the original VAT liability reduction (need G/L codes from Marcus).
3) Escrow any disputed credits separately until Vertex confirms final sign-off (KPMG may request source docs).

Can you draft the journal entries we should post and confirm the G/L and reversal timing (cutoff Q3). Also looping KPMG APAC — their audit request list is coming; attaching the initial ask they provided.

Thanks — I can coordinate the cutover and will hold off posting until we confirm with you and KPMG.

Soojin
[Attachment: kpmg_req_list.pdf (pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Sep 2028 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Subscription credits applied to September invoices — journal entries + playbook link

Thanks for forwarding — reviewed the Vertex schedule. Draft journal plan below (high level):

- Journal JRN-2028-AR-0929-01: Debit unapplied credits (Liability: CR-UNAPPL), Credit Accounts Receivable (Customer AR) for the sum of credits applied per invoice.
- Journal JRN-2028-VAT-0929-02: Debit VAT Payable (LIAB: VAT-PAY) and Credit VAT recontra (EXP: VAT-REV) for VAT-flagged credit amounts — this reverses the original VAT liability. We will include the Vertex bank reference VTX-SWEEP-0922 on both journals for audit trace.
- Cutoff: post on 2028-09-29 EOD to lock into Q3.

I uploaded a step-by-step checklist to the finance drive (link below) — it includes the mapping template and the GL map for VAT reversal. Please confirm:
- Marcus: can you confirm GL codes VAT-PAY and VAT-REV map to main ledger?
- Soojin: once we have confirmation from Vertex on the signed remittance PDF and KPMG's doc list, we'll post.

Link: https://drive.redwood.com/finance/plays/subscription-credit-proration-2028

Laura Bennett
Senior Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference
[Journal refs: JRN-2028-AR-0929-01, JRN-2028-VAT-0929-02]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Sep 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: journal entries + VAT G/L mapping

Laura — GL codes confirmed. Quick notes:
- VAT-PAY = 2110-VAT-STD
- VAT-REV = 6110-VAT-REV
- For bookkeeping: include customer tax ID where vertex flagged vat_flag = YES; that'll make the audit tracers clean.

Operational ask: Soojin, when you prepare the import for the unapplied credits, please add a column 'source_bank_ref' and populate with VTX-SWEEP-0922 for those rows. Also tag any credits that are "pro-rated" vs full-credit in an 'alloc_type' column (values = FULL, PRORATE). We'll need to run a separate revenue recognition adjustment for PRORATE rows; I can draft that adjustment entry after we confirm amounts.

I'll queue JRN-2028-AR-0929-01 for review in the ledger system and share with Laura for sign-off.

Marcus Lin
Accounting Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
